_help: Approved exceptions for the VAPT gate. Each entry needs id, reason, approved_by and expires (YYYY-MM-DD). Expired or incomplete entries are ignored (and listed in the report). id is a finding id from report.json, e.g. 'npm:GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx:next'; end it with * to match a prefix. Changes to this file should be reviewed (see deploy/SECURITY-AND-LOGGING.md).
